simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גֶּלֶד (H1539) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: גֶּלֶד (geled) means the (human) skin (as smooth) First listed occurrence: Job 16 15.

definitions.full: H1539. geled [ גֶּ֫לֶד ] noun masculine skin (Arabic , Aramaic גִּלְדָּא , ) of man Job 16:15 גִלְדִּ֑י עֲלֵי תָּפַרְתִּי שַׂק .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root probably meaning to polish;
